steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen requested by the case.
Enable eRFX capability required by the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation so publishing is available.
Configure the closest supported single-stage auction baseline; sealed bidding is not exposed by this domain step.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Add the requested product with quantity 10.
Populate the pricing sheet so the event can be scheduled and published.
Set the requested delivery location on the first line item.

args.goal: On the auction configuration screen, select the sealed bid strategy if the product offers it, and stop with the selected strategy visible

steps.note: Attempt the strategy selection that has no dedicated catalog step.
Verify that the sealed strategy is visibly selected if the on-screen action succeeded.
Invite three QA vendors corresponding to Vendors A, B, and C.
Commit the requested 30-minute schedule starting now.
Publish the auction so vendors can bid.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Submit Vendor A's bid of 100 through the vendor portal.
Confirm the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit a different vendor's bid of 95 through the vendor portal.
Confirm the second vendor bid was accepted.
Inspect the invited QA vendor's supplier-side view.
Open the event's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Check that the inspected vendor does not see a rank during bidding.
Check that the inspected vendor does not see a best-price indicator during bidding.
Return to the buyer console to inspect the response view.
Assert that the buyer sees both submitted vendor responses and the 2-of-3 participation count.
